quarterly_data.signal: 10-Q: capital expenditures were $1.19 billion in the first six months of 2026 versus $2.43 billion in the year-ago period, and CHIPS Act incentives provided cash proceeds of $1.10 billion in the period. Of direct CHIPS Act funding of up to $1.6 billion for its three large-scale 300mm wafer fabs in Sherman, Texas, and Lehi, Utah, TI has received $630 million. TI owns and operates wafer fabrication and assembly/test facilities, selectively uses outside foundries and subcontractors, and expects its internal sourcing to continue to increase with its planned capacity expansions.
